source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.2 with Figs. 3.6 to 3.10 and Examples 3.2 and 3.3 (PDF 59-62).

blocks.text: Newton ka doosra qanoon kehta hai ke jab jism par force lage to woh usi simt mein acceleration paida karti hai. Chalte jism par us ki velocity ki simt mein lagne wali force velocity ki miqdar (speed) badalti hai, simt wahi rakhte hue. Doosri taraf dairawi raste par chalte jism ki velocity par amood lagne wali mustaqil force simt badalti hai magar velocity ki miqdar (speed) wahi rehti hai. Aisi force radial (ya centripetal) acceleration paida kar ke jism ko daire mein chalati hai aur centripetal (markaz-ju, centre-seeking) force kehlati hai. Fig. 3.6a dori ke sire se bandhi gend dikhati hai jo ufqi satah mein ghumai ja rahi hai; agar dori toot jaye to woh dairawi raste par nahi chalegi: jab gend nuqte A par ho aur dori toote (Fig. 3.6b) to gend seedhi lakeer AB par chalti hai, jo A par tangent hai. Dairawi harkat mein harkat ki simt lagatar badalti hai (Do You Know).

blocks.alt: Ek shakhs ufuqi rangeen disc ke neeche khara hai jo daire ki satah dikhati hai. Us ka utha hua haath markaz par dori pakarta hai; dori daire ke kinare par gend tak jati hai. Dori par teer F gend se haath ki taraf hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.6(a): Dori se bandhi gend ufuqi daire mein ghumai ja rahi hai (kitab ki Figure 3.6(a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Markaz O wala daira, us par teer anticlockwise harkat dikhata hai. Daire par nuqte A se O tak lakeer, us par teer F O ki taraf. A se tangent ke saath dashed teer B par khatam hota hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.6(b): Agar dori A par toot jaye to gend tangent AB par chalti hai (kitab ki Figure 3.6(b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Force F hamesha markaz O ki taraf hai aur gend ki velocity tangent ke saath. Jab tak dori kheenchti hai, gend ka raasta daira rehta hai. A par dori toot jaye to force khatam ho jati hai aur gend us lamhe ki velocity ke saath seedhi lakeer AB (tangent) par chal parti hai, bahar ki taraf nahi.

blocks.alt: Daire par kai nuqte, har ek par tangent ke saath velocity ka teer v; sab teer barabar lambe hain magar jism clockwise ghoomte hue un ki simt badalti jati hai. Ek nuqte par agla velocity teer usi dum (tail) par la kar banaya gaya hai, dashed lakeer yeh muntaqili dikhati hai, aur dono siron ko jorne wala chhota teer, jo daire ke andar ki taraf hai, delta v hai.
blocks.caption: Do You Know (PDF page 59): dairawi harkat mein harkat ki simt lagatar badalti hai (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Speed har jagah barabar hai, phir bhi velocity badal rahi hai kyunke us ki simt badalti hai. Do qareebi velocities ka farq delta v daire ke markaz ki taraf hota hai. Isi liye dairawi harkat mein acceleration aur force markaz ki taraf hoti hai, yani centripetal.

Yun yaksan speed wali dairawi harkat ke har nuqte par velocity ki simt lagatar badalne ke liye force chahiye. Woh force jo speed nahi balke har nuqte par sirf simt badalti hai, dairawi raste ke radius ke saath lagne wali amood force hai; yeh hamesha cheez ko markaz ki taraf kheenchti hai, aur us ki simt har nuqte par tangential velocity par amood hai.

blocks.title: Centripetal force
blocks.text: Zarre ke seedhe raste ko dairawi raste mein morne ke liye darkar force centripetal force kehlati hai. Radius r ke dairawi raste par velocity v se chalte mass m ke jism ke liye Fc = m a_c = m v^2 / r ... (3.12), jahan a_c = v^2/r centripetal acceleration hai, jis ki simt daire ke markaz ki taraf hai. Chunke v = r omega, Fc = m r omega^2 ... (3.13).

blocks.title: Example 3.2
blocks.text: Agar 12 cm diameter ki CD 210 rpm par ghoome to us ke bahri kinare par nuqte ka radial acceleration kya hai? Hal: 210 rpm ko revolutions per second mein frequency banayein: f = 210 rev/min x (1/60) min/s = 3.5 rev/s = 3.5 Hz. Har revolution mein CD 2 pi radians ghoomti hai, to omega = 2 pi f = 2 pi x 3.5 rev/s = 7.0 pi rad s^-1. Radial acceleration a = omega^2 r = (7.0 pi rad s^-1)^2 x 0.06 m = 29 m s^-2.

blocks.title: Example 3.3
blocks.text: Dori ke sire se bandhi gend gravity ke tahat radius r ke amoodi daire mein ghumai jati hai (Fig. 3.7). Jab gend raste ke sab se oonche nuqte A par ho aur wahan us ki speed v ho to dori mein tension kya hogi? Hal: gend ke daire mein chalne ke liye us par lagne wali force darkar centripetal force deni chahiye. A par gend par do forces lagti hain, dori ka kheench T aur us ka wazan w; dono A par radius ke saath lagti hain, to un ka vector majmooa centripetal force dena chahiye: T + w = m v^2 / r, aur chunke w = mg, T = m v^2 / r - mg = m (v^2/r - g). Agar v^2/r = g ho to T sifr hai aur centripetal force bilkul wazan ke barabar hai.

blocks.alt: Amoodi daira, markaz O aur sab se ooncha nuqta A. A par naranji teer v tangent ke saath baen taraf hai, aur AO ke saath do neeche ke teer hain: chhota neela w aur lamba hara T. Daire par teer dikhata hai ke gend anticlockwise ghoomti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.7: Amoodi daire mein ghoomti gend: oopar nuqte A par tension T aur wazan w dono AO ke saath (kitab ki Figure 3.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar wale nuqte A par dori ki tension T aur gend ka wazan w dono neeche, markaz O ki taraf hain, is liye dono mil kar centripetal force dete hain: T + w = m v^2 / r. Velocity v tangent ke saath hai, force ke amood (perpendicular). Agar v^2/r = g ho to T sifr ho jati hai aur sirf wazan centripetal force deta hai.
Har dairawi ya madari harkat mein centripetal force chahiye, jo koi na koi zariya deta hai:

items: Jab gend dori se ufqi daire mein ghumai jaye to dori ki tension zaroori centripetal force deti hai.
Turntable par rakhi cheez ke liye raghrat (friction) centripetal force hai.
Gravitational force Zameen ke Suraj ke gird, aur Chand aur masnooi satellites ke Zameen ke gird ghoomne ki wajah hai.
Amood (normal) magnetic force seedhe raste par chalte charged zarre ko dairawi raste par majboor karti hai.

Jab gari sarak par murti hai to use bhi centripetal force chahiye, jo tyres aur sarak ke darmiyan raghrat deti hai. Agar sarak phisalni ho to tez raftar par raghrat zaroori centripetal force dene ko kafi nahi ho sakti; gari mor nahi kaat sakti aur phisal ya ulat sakti hai. Is mushkil par qaboo pane ko highway moron par banked hoti hai: track ka bahri kinara andaruni kinare se thora ooncha rakha jata hai. Itni tezi se kate moron ke liye banked tracks chahiye jahan akeli raghrat centripetal force nahi de sakti (Tid-bits).

blocks.text: Cheez centripetal force ki wajah se daire mein chalti hai; agar lagai gayi force ki miqdar darkar centripetal force se kam reh jaye to cheez daire ke markaz se door chali jati hai. Centrifuge (Fig. 3.8a) isi usool par kaam karta hai.

blocks.caption: Istemalat
header: Centripetal force kaise istemal hoti hai
rows: laboratory ke sab se mufeed aalon mein se ek; mixture ko khaas waqt tak tez raftar se ghumaya jata hai taake ghane aur halke zarraat alag hon; sample tubes mein ghane zarraat pende mein beth jate hain aur halke oopar aa jate hain (Fig. 3.8b)

deewar mein saikron chhote soorakhon wala lamba cylinder; geele kapre is mein dale jate hain aur cylinder apne axis ke gird tezi se ghumaya jata hai; pani bahar deewaron ki taraf jata hai aur soorakhon se nikal jata hai, to kapre jaldi sookh jate hain (Fig. 3.9)

doodh, halke aur bhari zarraat ka mixture, tezi se ghumaya jata hai; halke zarraat gardish ke axis ke qareeb jama hote hain jabke bhari zarraat bahar jate hain, to cream doodh se aasani se alag ho jati hai (Fig. 3.10)

blocks.alt: Amoodi shaft par hub aur do ufuqi baazu. Har baazu ke sire par holder ek sample tube pakarta hai jo bahar ki taraf leti hai, us ka band gol sira shaft se door. Shaft ke gird mura teer gardish dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.8(b): Centrifuge ki sample tubes, jin mein ghani (denser) zarraat tah (bottom) par baith jate hain (kitab ki Figure 3.8(b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tez gardish mein tube ke andar ke zarraat ko daire mein chalane ke liye centripetal force chahiye. Bhaari (ghane) zarraat ko zyada force chahiye jo maye (liquid) poori nahi kar pata, is liye woh bahar ki taraf, tube ke band sire (tah) par jama ho jate hain, aur halke zarraat oopar, shaft ki taraf rehte hain.

blocks.prompt: 0.5 m lambi dori zyada se zyada 35.6 N tension sah sakti hai. Zyada se zyada speed nikalein jis se 0.5 kg ka patthar us se amoodi daire mein ghumaya ja sake (numerical problem 3.4). Car ke liye tez raftar par morna mushkil kyun hai, aur tez sharp mor par hum kyun lurhakte hain (short question 3.5, constructed response 3.3)?
blocks.explanation: Tension daire ke neeche sab se zyada hai, jahan T - mg = m v^2 / r, to 35.6 - 0.5 x 9.8 = 0.5 v^2 / 0.5, jis se v^2 = 30.7 aur v = 5.5 m s^-1. Centripetal force m v^2 / r speed ke muraba se barhti hai, to tez raftar par tyres aur sarak ki raghrat kafi nahi ho sakti aur car phisalti hai; hamare jism seedhi lakeer mein chalte rehna chahte hain (inertia) jabke gari murti hai, to hum bahar ki taraf jhukte hain aur lurhak sakte hain.

items: Amood force sirf velocity ki simt badalti hai: centripetal force Fc = m v^2 / r = m r omega^2, radius ke saath markaz ki taraf; is ke baghair jism tangent par nikal jata hai. Amoodi daire ki choti: T = m (v^2/r - g).

Dori ki tension, raghrat (turntable, tyres), gravity (madar), magnetic force deti hai; tez moron par banked sarkein. Istemalat: centrifuge, washing-machine dryer, cream separator. Example 3.2: 29 m s^-2.
